answer: Seed each epoch with honeypot tasks whose answers are already known to be wrong. Send them into the queue like real work. Any agent that grades a honeypot as correct is flagged, and its verdicts are dropped from the panel. Split the audit across independent pools and require quorum across unrelated subnetworks, so a bought panel cannot cover the trap. One wrong grade costs the agent its season, and the flag is pigment that follows it into every later panel. The atlas of known-bad cases grows every epoch, and each entry is a dune the farm has to cross blind.
